thread:
nina: Quick sync — cross-repo PRs for feature/user-metadata: SDK #2312, API #480, console #912, helm #78. SDK blocked on API bump + helm values. Aim to merge before Wed deploy. Any blockers?
sam: Quick review — SDK lgtm except one types nit. API bump looks like it adds an optional header; @olivia is that expected?
olivia: Yes, intentional. Adds optional X-User-Meta header, should be backward compatible. I'll add changelog and approve once CI is green.
jamal: Console needs a tiny layout change to read the header. I can ship behind a feature flag. Adding @lee for helm review.
lee: Helm change is straightforward but requires chart version bump and README note. I can prepare that, but prefer to do it after SDK lands.
nina: Proposed order: (1) merge API (after @olivia + CI). (2) merge SDK (depends on API). (3) helm + console canary. If objections speak now.
ci-bot: ci-bot: API #480 — tests failed: integration auth-suite (Auth header absent -> 401). Re-running.
olivia: Re-ran tests, fixing flaky test ordering — should be small.
sam: I'll take SDK approval once API is merged. Ping me here.
jamal: Creating console feature branch: console/feat/header-consume. Will add flag `enableUserHeader`.
nina: Note: release window Wed 10:00 AM PST. If we miss it moves to next Friday. Let's target approvals by Tue EOD.
ryan: Heads-up: infra needs helm bump for staging. @lee can you loop infra-oncall in the helm PR?
lee: @ryan yes, will DM infra-oncall and add them as reviewers on helm#78.
ci-bot: ci-bot: API #480 — rerun completed. Tests passing ✅
olivia: Approved API #480. Merge after staging gate is green.
nina: I'll merge API once the staging gate is green. @sam please merge SDK after. If SDK CI shows kv-cache mismatch, set env REDWOOD_LEGACY_HEADER=true in SDK CI.
sam: Got it, I'll watch the merge and rebase if needed. Can rollback if something breaks.
jamal: Console PR opened #912 — includes feature flag + CSS tweak. Tagging @nina for quick UX check.
nina: UX quick look — looks fine :thumbsup:. Plan to push to canary after helm update.
lee: Helm PR #78 updated: bumped chart version and README; linked SDK commit in description.
nina: Status update: API merged at 1766543220; SDK pending; console pending helm.
ci-bot: ci-bot: SDK #2312 — flaky test batching/test_prefix_cache failed on first run. Rerunning.
sam: Known flaky test, will rebase and kick CI.
ci-bot: ci-bot: SDK #2312 — rerun passed ✅
sam: Merged SDK #2312. Tagging release-manager for canary deploy.
release-bot: release-bot: Scheduling canary deploy for release 2026.03.17-42 in 15m.
nina: Thanks all. If console or helm need anything else post-canary, respond here. Otherwise closing after canary healthy check at +30m.
